name: sub_sitrus_tie
purpose: Substitute succeeds and fails with two Sitrus holders at equal speed on opposite sides (decision 0032 addendum, lead's report of the lane A Substitute bug): Umbreon (M) on each side holds Sitrus Berry and has the same spread, so their speeds tie; on turn 1 Umbreon raises a Substitute (success: the cost, then the two each:Update events of the Champions hit loop, which draw the speed tie of the holders), on turn 2 it raises one again (EXISTS: no Update). Champions hitStepMoveHitLoop: data/mods/champions/scripts.ts:537 and :574; the fail paths return NOT_FAIL before the hit loop (sim/battle-actions.ts:602-611, 643-652).
